decisions.reason: As a newly launched supplement range with its own page, it is a low-cost option to keep open for another year while market demand becomes clearer.
The dedicated launch positioning suggests some commercial commitment, and in a crowded but inexpensive supplement category it is still worth waiting for more information before abandoning it.
This joint-health supplement looks like a smaller trial with less prominence, but its carrying cost is likely modest so the firm would usually keep the option alive a bit longer.
A mushroom-based immune supplement is relatively niche and uncertain, yet because it is early and probably cheap to maintain the firm would more likely continue observing than exit immediately.
